rci5_n.detail: Training phase reference controls for initial model training (ADNI) and transfer learning (ADRC).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The ADNI-CU group was further divided into a training set for model training (ADNI-CU-train; n = 326), a holdout validation set (ADNI-CU-holdout; n = 65), and a test set (ADNI-CU-test; n = 43) at a ratio of 75:15:10 (Figure 1A)." "Similarly, the ADRC-CU group was also divided into a training set for transfer learning on the replication dataset (ADRC-CU-tl; n = 225), a holdout validation set (ADRC-CU-holdout; n = 45), and a test set (ADRC-CU-test; n = 31) (Figure 1B)."
